units: <cite ref="Yoma 72b:7">Yoma 72ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="M00023"><he>מאי</he></cite> (<cite ref="F00000"><he>ו</he></cite>)<he>משהו ז׳</he> what purpose serves the ‘something’ (over ten handbreadths)? It is the space for the rim.
Ib. כתיב זר וקרי זיר וכ׳ it is written (in the Bible) זר (which allows the reading זָר) and is read zer; if you are worthy, the Law is to you a crown, &c., v. זוּר; a. fr.—Pl. זִירִין.
<cite ref="Yoma 72b:6">Ib.</cite> <he>שלשה ז׳</he> three crowns (of vessels of the sanctuary).

senses.gloss: crest, customary addition to dry measure; v. גֵּירוּמִין. Sifra K’dosh. Par. 3, ch. VIII ‘in m’surah’ (Lev. XIX, 35) זו ז׳ הגדול that means the large crest.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 4:5">Maasr. IV, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 7b:11">Ab. Zar. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>השבת … זרע וירק וז׳</he> the dill-plant is subject to tithes when its seeds are collected, or when its leaves are used as vegetable, or when its pods are eaten.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 4:4:2">Y. Maasr. IV, 51ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>זרעה לז׳</he> if he planted it for the sake of the pods; <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 2:7">Tosef. Shebi. II, 7</cite> <he>זרעה ז׳</he> (read <he>לז׳</he>).

senses.gloss: (v. זוּר Pa., cmp. זֶרֶת) small bundle, bunch, contrad. to חֲבִילָה.—Pl. as above.—Y. Ter. X, 47ᵇ top; Y. Orl. III, 63ᵃ bot. כ״ה ז׳ a ḥăbilah is twenty five bunches.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 24:2">Sabb. XXIV, 2</cite>, contrad. to <cite ref="Q01492"><he>פְּקִיעִין</he></cite> a. <he>כִּיפִין</he>; expl.

ib. 155ᵃ ז׳ דארזי, v. אַרְזָא; ib. (anoth. defin.) ז׳ תלתא they are called zirin when tied with three bands; [Var. lect. זֵרִין, זידין, זיזין, זְרָדִין, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 80, a. marginal note in Talm. ed.].
